content.text: Medical: mifepristone followed by misoprostol 24-48hrs after (safe up to 10wks)
Mifepristone: progesterone receptor antagonist (leads to dilation & softening of the cervix & placental separation)
Misoprostol: prostaglandin E1 analog (causes uterine contractions) – pt must return 7-14d after mifepristone to confirm complete termination of pregnancy
